tests.signTest: cluster sign test, two-sided exact binomial, alpha 0.05
tests.signFlip: exact sign-flip test of summed cluster differences, two-sided, alpha 0.05

rule.settled: performed contrasts with profile p < 0.001 in every cohort
rule.retain: a cohort x family x level with at least 4 of 12 discordant pairs in some open planned comparison
rule.add: one level 1.5x above a retained family's top level where an arm still passes more than half there
rule.material: performed levels need fresh low-overlap windows (only 128-note range-edit has them)
